evaluation.per_sample_scores: out-of-fold: every sample is scored by the fold model that never saw it (scripts/step3_ml_structural.py, OOF loop); see results/scores_m2.csv, scores_m3.csv, scores_m4.csv, final_scores.csv
evaluation.split_exporter: splits/export_splits.py  (run with --verify to prove the splits reproduce results/scores_m3.csv exactly)

corpus.manifest: manifest/sample_hashes.csv (SHA-256 / MD5 of every evaluated sample; binaries not redistributed)

M1_exact_hash.method: SHA-256 / MD5 exact match against the known-sample manifest

M2_fuzzy_hash.method: CTPH via ppdeep (pure-Python SSDeep); Jaccard 4-gram fallback

M3_structural_ml.features: 54 PE structural features = FEATURE_COLS in scripts/step3_ml_structural.py

M4_deep_semantic.architecture: embedding -> parallel Conv1D (k=3, k=5; 128 filters each) -> concat -> BiLSTM(64) -> dropout -> sigmoid

fusion.method: NDR - Normalized Dynamic Redistribution over active modalities: w_k,eff = w_k / sum_{j in A} w_j

hardware: Intel Core i7-13700H, 16 GB DDR5-5200, NVIDIA RTX 4060 Laptop (8 GB), Windows 11
